The Congolian rainforest (also known as the Congo rainforest or the Congo Basin rainforest) is the world's second-largest tropical rainforest and contains approximately one quarter of the total area of remaining tropical forests on Earth. It spans across six countries in Central Africa and is one of the largest and most biodiverse tracts of tropical rainforest in the world, home to millions of species of plants, animals, and insects.
